description: git fetch and push without a credential in the jail: the jail's git reaches the git-broker on the host, which connects to this workspace's approved remotes the way the host does (its SSH keys or agent, or its git credential helper over HTTPS), once a read grant in config allows it (it grants nothing by default), streams fetches back, pushes only the branches a create-branch grant lets it create and the ones it created since (its working set), refuses every other push per ref, and audits every call.
name: git
